workshopsData.title: The Ultimate RC Plane Workshop
workshopsData.description: Drishti'26 × AeroCET presents The Ultimate RC Plane Workshop. Explore the fundamentals of aerodynamics, aircraft design and flight control as you configure your very own RC aircraft and put it to the test. 📅 September 18, 19 and 20. Let your vision soar the skies ✨ Your vision. Your Drishti.
details: Workshop Focus : Aerodynamics · Aircraft Design · Flight Control.
Experience : Configure your own RC aircraft and put it to the test.
Passes : 1 Day Workshop Pass · 3 Day Workshop Pass.

workshopsData.title: SolidWorks Online Workshop
workshopsData.description: From Vision to dimension. Drishti’26 × Herakles brings you SolidWorks Online Workshop 🚀 The one session your ideas need to take shape! Your vision. Your Drishti.

workshopsData.title: MATLAB Workshop
workshopsData.description: Code your concepts into Vision. Join Drishti’26 × Herakles for the MATLAB Workshop and explore MATLAB from the fundamentals of coding to practical applications.

workshopsData.title: ANSYS Online Workshop
workshopsData.description: Analyze beyond the blueprint. Drishti’26 × Herakles brings you ANSYS Online Workshop. Turn engineering ideas into something you can test, analyse and perfect. Your vision. Your Drishti.

workshopsData.title: Unreal Engine Workshop
workshopsData.description: Join Drishti’26 × Glitch CET for Unreal Engine: Introduction to Game Development. A hands-on, 6-hour beginner workshop led by Muhammed Faizal PK, founder, Custodian Games.

workshopsData.title: Privatisation of Space Industry
workshopsData.description: Join industry experts and space-sector pioneers as they delve into the opportunities, challenges, and future of India’s rapidly evolving private space industry.

workshopsData.title: PCB Design Workshop
workshopsData.description: Homegrown talent leading the hardware revolution. Two of our very own CET alumnae are returning to campus as industry powerhouses to show you how real-world boards are engineered. Organized by Drishti’26 × IET

workshopsData.title: Beyond Progress: Humanity's future in a changing cosmos
workshopsData.description: Join us for an insightful conversation on humanity, science, progress, and our place in a rapidly changing cosmos featuring Jithinraj R S (Founder, JR Studio | Journalist | Science Communicator).

workshopsData.title: DECODING AI
workshopsData.description:
AI is everywhere, but what is really going on behind the hood?
It’s time to look beyond the prompts and understand what makes AI tick.
details: Speaker: Dr. Deepak Mishra - IIST, Thiruvananthapuram

workshopsData.title: WHEN LIGHT GOES QUANTUM : PHOTONS & TECHNOLOGY
workshopsData.description:
What if the smallest particles could power the biggest breakthroughs? 
Step into the world of quantum computing and technology.
details: Speaker: Dr. Ashok Kumar, Associate Professor, Department of Physics, IIST.

workshopsData.title: VERILOG AND FPGA
workshopsData.description: What if the logic you write could actually come alive on a chip? Step into the world of VLSI and digital design, get started with Verilog HDL, and explore hands-on FPGA implementation using Xilinx Vivado — where theory meets real-world chip design. Organized by Drishti'26 × RoboCET

workshopsData.title: TinyML: From Zero to Edge Intelligence
workshopsData.alt: TinyML: From Zero to Edge Intelligence Workshop
workshopsData.description: Drishti'26 × IEEE SB CET presents TinyML: From Zero to Edge Intelligence Workshop. Discover how intelligence moves from the cloud to the edge, giving tiny devices a brain of their own. Featuring Abhinav Krishna N, Ranger Seeed Studio.
details: Format : Offline. Ensure laptops for the session.
Speaker : Abhinav Krishna N, Ranger Seeed Studio.

workshopsData.title: Building an 8-Bit Computer Workshop
workshopsData.description: Drishti'26 × Her Aura presents Building an 8-Bit Computer Workshop. Forget just using a computer — get behind the logic that makes one work. Get hands-on with the fundamentals of digital computing and explore how simple components come together to create a working 8-bit computer. Build. Connect. Understand.
details: Format : Offline. Ensure laptops for the session.

workshopsData.title: OpenCV Workshop on Computer Vision
workshopsData.description: Drishti'26 × AstroCET presents OpenCV Workshop on Computer Vision. Images are everywhere. But making a computer understand them? That's where things get interesting. Step into Computer Vision with OpenCV and explore how machines detect, recognise, and make sense of what they see. No magic. Just pixels, code, and a whole new way of looking at things.
details: Format : Offline. Ensure laptops for the session.

workshopsData.title: Robotic Arm Development Workshop
workshopsData.description: Drishti'26 × AstroCET presents Robotic Arm Development Workshop. Go beyond watching robots move and actually understand what makes them move. Get introduced to robotic arm development and explore the world where engineering, automation, and robotics come together.
details: Format : Online. Ensure laptops for the session.

workshopsData.title: Nix & NixOS
workshopsData.description: Shift from fragile setups to immutable perfection. Join Vysakh Premkumar to unlock pure declarative power and eliminate 'works on my machine' forever with Drishti'26 x FOSS CET.

workshopsData.title: ETABS
workshopsData.description: Every strong structure starts as numbers on a screen. ETABS is where engineers turn sketches into certainty. Come learn how the strongest buildings actually get made with Drishti'26 x ICI CET

workshopsData.title: Race Car Dynamics
workshopsData.description: Speed has its own language. Force. Motion. Control. Learn how calculations, control, and engineering come together in Race Car Dynamics with Drishti'26 x Zenith.

workshopsData.title: Arduino
workshopsData.description: From code to circuits, turn your ideas into something you can actually build. Get hands-on with Arduino, explore the world of electronics, and bring your own ideas to life with Drishti'26 x Herakles.

workshopsData.title: Fig My UI: Figma
workshopsData.guidelinesTitle: FIG MY UI: FIGMA WORKSHOP DETAILS
workshopsData.description: A screen is never just a screen. Shift a shape. Change a flow. Turn an idea into something people can actually use. Learn to transform ideas into usable interfaces with Drishti'26 x TinkerHub CET.

workshopsData.title: Industrial Automation
workshopsData.description: Step into the world of industrial automation and explore input components, relays, PLCs, PLC programming, PLC communication, ladder diagrams, common PLC ladder program instructions and SCADA with Drishti ’26 × Excelerators CET.

workshopsData.title: Cloud Computing and Agentic AI
workshopsData.alt: Cloud Computing and Agentic AI Learning Circle
workshopsData.description: Explore the world of Cloud Computing and Agentic AI, learn from experts, and discover what’s next in technology at this Learning Circle presented by Drishti ’26 × μLearn.
details: Reward : $5 Google Cloud credit per participant.

workshopsData.title: Sensor Fusion 101
workshopsData.description: Explore how drones, robots, and autonomous systems understand motion and their surroundings through sensors and sensor fusion. Learn about IMUs, accelerometers, gyroscopes, and basic sensor fusion algorithms through a 6-hour hands-on workshop with real hardware, presented by Drishti’26 × Velocet.
details: Hands-on With : ESP32/Arduino Nano & MPU6050 IMU.
Requirement : Laptop with Arduino IDE installed.
Outcome : Understand and implement the fundamentals of sensor fusion.
Enquiries : Govind G - +91 70255 60765 · Karthik M Raj - +91 85479 2016.

workshopsData.title: Dance Workshop
workshopsData.description: Step into an energetic dance session where rhythm meets expression and every move comes alive. Join instructor Nadeem for an engaging dance workshop presented by Drishti ’26 × CET Dance Club.
details: Registration Fee : ₹250/- for CETians, ₹300/- for Non-CETians.

workshopsData.title: Blender Workshop
workshopsData.description: Bring your ideas to life in 3D. Dive into Blender and explore the world of 3D modelling, design, and creativity with Drishti ’26.

workshopsData.title: DaVinci Workshop
workshopsData.description: Turn your footage into stories that stand out. Learn the essentials of video editing, colour grading, and visual storytelling using DaVinci Resolve with Drishti ’26.

workshopsData.title: Bulb Making Workshop
workshopsData.description: Everything looks different when you make it yourself. Get hands-on and discover what actually goes into making a bulb by learning the process and creating one yourself with Drishti ’26 × NSS.

workshopsData.title: Live RAG-Powered Assistant
workshopsData.description: What if your AI could search, understand, and respond with real-time information? Step into the world of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and explore how AI-powered assistants turn information into intelligent answers with Drishti ’26 × NeuraCET.

workshopsData.title: AI Debate Arena
workshopsData.description: Step into the arena where ideas clash, perspectives collide, and Artificial Intelligence becomes the topic of debate. Bring your arguments, defend your stance, and challenge the other side at AI Debate Arena by Drishti ’26 × NeuraCET.

workshopsData.title: Crochet Workshop
workshopsData.description: Ready to get your hands a little busier? Pick up the basics of crochet and turn a simple thread into something of your own. Come curious, learn the craft, and make something you’ll actually want to keep with Drishti ’26 × NSS.

workshopsData.title: VOICEBOT - Build. Program. Command.
workshopsData.alt: VOICEBOT voice-controlled mobile bot workshop poster
workshopsData.description: Ever imagined controlling a robot just by speaking? Step into the world of robotics and bring your own voice-controlled mobile bot to life with Drishti ’26 × Build Club CET.
